WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    t.team_id,
    AVG(CASE WHEN mh.w IS NOT NULL AND mh.g IS NOT NULL AND mh.g > 0 
             THEN CAST(mh.w AS FLOAT) / CAST(mh.g AS FLOAT) 
             ELSE NULL END) as avg_win_rate,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN mh.player_id IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as manager_count
  FROM team t
  LEFT JOIN manager_half mh ON t.team_id = mh.team_id
  GROUP BY t.team_id
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_win_rate) as overall_avg_win_rate
  FROM step1
)
SELECT 
  s1.team_id,
  s1.avg_win_rate,
  s1.manager_count,
  s1.avg_win_rate - s2.overall_avg_win_rate as diff
FROM step1 s1, step2 s2
WHERE s2.overall_avg_win_rate IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY diff DESC
LIMIT 10
